messages.label: scam
messages.text: BPD Traffic Dept: Our records show your vehicle was cited for a red light offence in Belmopan on 02/11. Outstanding amount BZ$120. Settle online before end of day to prevent suspension of your licence [link]
messages.note: Fake police traffic fine with payment link and licence threat

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Need money for Christmas? 🎄 We approve loans up to $20k in minutes, bad credit ok. Only requirement is a $150 activation fee sent to our agent, then we release the full amount to your account same day. DM us
messages.note: Online loan that needs an upfront fee

messages.label: scam
messages.text: ATTENTION BUSINESS OWNERS: Government has approved a second round of the MSME Tax Amnesty. All arrears and penalties cleared. Submit your TIN, owner ID and phone in our inbox before the 30th to be enrolled. Spaces limited.
messages.note: Fake tax amnesty extension collecting business details

messages.label: scam
messages.text: BPS Notice: A package in your name could not be delivered, the street address on file is missing. Please confirm your delivery info here so we can dispatch it [link]
messages.note: Fake postal service parcel text with link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi Ms. Flowers, I'm with the Belize Bank security department. Somebody tried to use your debit card in Mexico. I can cancel it right now but first I need you to read me the 16 digits on your card and your PIN so the system knows it's you.
messages.note: Bank impersonation call asking for card number and PIN

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good morning, this is Mr. Daniels, Central Bank of Belize supervision office. We are reviewing accounts affected by fraud. Kindly join this Google Meet at 10am and have your bank login and debit card on hand for verification [link]
messages.note: Central Bank impersonation with video call asking for banking details

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, you have been registered for the fishermen cooperative support meeting on Zoom tonight. A verification number was sent to your phone by SMS, please forward it here so we can add you to the meeting list
messages.note: Hard: meeting invite that asks for the WhatsApp registration code

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Belize International Airport is clearing out baggage nobody collected 🧳 Every suitcase sold for $4 to support local charity, contents not checked. Ships nationwide. Get yours before they run out [link]
messages.note: Fake airport luggage sale with payment link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Bro I have a link inside the draws. Tonight's Boledo number is sure, ask anybody I gave it to. $40 on Digi and I send it to you before 7. Don't share it
messages.note: Hard: paid lottery tips, casual tone

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Belize Bank Customer Rewards 🎁 You are one of 50 clients chosen to receive $300 into your savings for our anniversary. Tap here and sign in with your online banking to accept your reward [link]
messages.note: Fake bank social profile with prize and login link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello dear, I am happy to tell you that you are among the winners of the Global Relief Grant. Your $30,000 is packed with the delivery company, the only thing left is to cover the shipping fee of $95 then the agent will bring it to your house.
messages.note: Hard: friendly stranger, grant prize with delivery fee

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Still have the washing machine yes. Lots of people want it so I can only keep it for you if you put $150 down. Account is in my sister name at the bank, send screenshot when done and I'll mark it sold for you
messages.note: Hard: seller wants deposit to a third-party account

messages.text: Hi, is the fridge still for sale? I'm in Ladyville, could I come see it Saturday morning? If it works good I'll bring the cash with me.
